title: Product, Order, Demand and Transaction Service Layer

interfaces.name: ProductService
methods: addProduct(String prodName, String prodType, String prodInfo, double prodPrice, int prodQuantity, InputStream prodImage): String

interfaces.name: DemandService
methods: addProduct(String userId, String prodId, int demandQty): boolean

implementations.name: ProductServiceImpl
notable_logic: addProduct(String...) delegates to addProduct(ProductBean) after calling IDUtil.generateId()
updateProductWithoutImage() detects stock increase → calls DemandServiceImpl.haveDemanded() → sends email via MailMessage.productAvailableNow() → calls DemandServiceImpl.removeProduct() per demander
All DB operations use DBUtil.provideConnection() / DBUtil.closeConnection()

implementations.name: OrderServiceImpl
notable_logic: paymentSuccess() orchestrates full checkout: CartServiceImpl.getAllCartItems() → ProductServiceImpl.getProductPrice() per item → addOrder() → CartServiceImpl.removeAProduct() → ProductServiceImpl.sellNProduct() → addTransaction() → MailMessage.transactionSuccess()
addOrder() inserts into 'orders' table with shipped=0 default
shipNow() updates orders SET shipped=1 WHERE orderid AND prodid AND shipped=0

implementations.name: DemandServiceImpl
notable_logic: addProduct(String,String,int) checks for existing demand before inserting (idempotent insert)
haveDemanded() queries user_demand table by prodId, returns list of DemandBean

implementations.name: TransServiceImpl
notable_logic: getUserId() queries transactions table by transId to return associated username

key_relationships: ProductServiceImpl depends_on DemandServiceImpl (calls haveDemanded, removeProduct in updateProductWithoutImage)
ProductServiceImpl depends_on UserServiceImpl (calls getFName for email notification)
OrderServiceImpl depends_on UserServiceImpl (calls getFName for email notification)
OrderServiceImpl uses OrderBean, TransactionBean, OrderDetails, CartBean
bean_types_used: ProductBean (prodId, prodName, prodType, prodInfo, prodPrice, prodQuantity, prodImage)
OrderDetails (orderId, productId, prodName, prodImage, qty, amount, time, shipped)
important_notes: No Spring/DI framework — impls instantiated directly with 'new'. Cross-service calls use concrete impl classes (new DemandServiceImpl(), new CartServiceImpl()), not interfaces. MailMessage is a static utility for email notifications. IDUtil.generateId() generates product IDs. OrderServiceImpl.paymentSuccess() is the main checkout orchestrator and touches 4 services.
